newsitem.title: USA: Shelby sees Q2 EPS above expectations.
newsitem.headline: Shelby sees Q2 EPS above expectations.

text.p: Shelby Williams Industries Inc said Thursday that second-quarter earnings will exceed analysts' median estimate of $0.26 per share.
"Management expects revenues for the second quarter to exceed $45 million," the company said.

"Near-record-high occupancy rates in the hotel industry continue to fuel hotel refurbishing projects," said Shelby Chief Executive Paul Steinfeld. "Shelby Williams is in a unique position, as the contract seating leader, to garner a growing share of that business."
The company is to report quarterly results July 9.
The company last year reported second-quarter earnings of $0.23 per share on revenues of $43.5 million.
